properties.description:
Centralised alerting pipeline — called by all other pipelines on failure OR success.

                   Alert channels:
                   - Azure Monitor (Log Analytics workspace: omnioc-dev-eus-law-01)
                   - Microsoft Teams webhook (via Web activity HTTP POST)
                   - Email via Logic App (or ADF email activity if configured)

                   severity parameter:
                   - SUCCESS  → green card in Teams, no email
                   - HIGH     → orange Teams card + email to data-eng@
                   - CRITICAL → red Teams card + email + pager (escalation)

                   Runs asynchronously from caller (waitOnCompletion: false in parent)
                   so pipeline failures don't block on alerting completion.

activities.name: Build Alert Message
activities.description: Compose alert message with run context.

value.value: @concat('OmniOC Lakehouse | ', pipeline().parameters.severity, ' | Pipeline: ', pipeline().parameters.pipeline_name, ' | RunID: ', pipeline().parameters.run_id, ' | ', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.severity,'SUCCESS'),'✅ Pipeline completed successfully.', concat('❌ FAILURE: ', pipeline().parameters.failure_reason)), ' | Time: ', utcNow())

activities.name: Send Teams Notification
activities.description:
POST to Microsoft Teams webhook.
                              Replace webhook URL with your actual Teams channel webhook.
                              Set secret in Key Vault: teams-webhook-url

body.value: @concat('{"@type":"MessageCard","@context":"https://schema.org/extensions","themeColor":"', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.severity,'SUCCESS'),'00FF00', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.severity,'CRITICAL'),'FF0000','FF8C00')), '","summary":"OmniOC Pipeline Alert","sections":[{"activityTitle":"OmniOC Lakehouse Alert","activitySubtitle":"', pipeline().parameters.severity, '","facts":[{"name":"Pipeline","value":"', pipeline().parameters.pipeline_name, '"},{"name":"RunID","value":"', pipeline().parameters.run_id, '"},{"name":"Details","value":"', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.failure_reason,''),'Completed OK', pipeline().parameters.failure_reason), '"},{"name":"Time (UTC)","value":"', utcNow(), '"}]}]}')

activities.name: Write to Log Analytics
activities.description:
Write structured alert to Azure Log Analytics workspace for dashboarding.
                              Uses HTTP Data Collector API — workspace ID from Key Vault.

activities.name: Email Alert for HIGH and CRITICAL
activities.description:
Send email via Logic App HTTP trigger for HIGH and CRITICAL severity.
                              SUCCESS alerts use Teams only — no email spam.

body.value: @concat('{"to":"data-eng@omnioc.com","subject":"[', pipeline().parameters.severity, '] OmniOC Pipeline Alert — ', pipeline().parameters.pipeline_name, '","body":"', variables('alert_message'), '"}')
